title: Multi-step SWE: Can Coding Agents Keep Building on Their Own Code Over Long Horizons?
abstract: arXiv:2611.07166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Developers rarely give a coding agent a single request: they ask it to build a component and then to extend, upgrade, and optimize it, each time on code the agent itself wrote. Most benchmarks, however, score one task at a time. We introduce Multi-step SWE, a long-horizon benchmark of 69 software engineering tasks, each a chain of 5-15 dependent steps on a single codebase. Every step is a complete, multi-hour engineering request that starts from the code the agent produced in the preceding steps, so early design decisions and errors carry forward. The tasks span four families of engineering work and nine languages, include both from-scratch builds and existing open-source codebases, and ground every step in an existing source of truth that defines both the instruction and its verifier. Across nine frontier models, the strongest model reaches a solve rate of only 18.5%, and 38 of the 69 tasks are not solved by any model. We release Mult

translated_title: 多步软件工程：编程智能体能否在长时程中持续基于自己编写的代码进行构建？
translated_abstract: 开发者很少只给编程智能体提出单次请求：他们通常要求智能体先构建一个组件，然后对其进行扩展、升级和优化，而每次操作都是基于智能体自己编写的代码。然而，大多数基准测试一次只评估单个任务。我们提出了 Multi-step SWE，这是一个包含69个软件工程任务的长时程基准，每个任务都是在单一代码库上由5-15个相互依赖的步骤组成的链条。每个步骤都是一个完整的多小时工程请求，它从智能体在前几步生成的代码开始，因此早期的设计决策和错误会延续下去。这些任务涵盖四大类工程工作和九种编程语言，既包括从零开始的构建，也包括现有的开源代码库，并且每一步都基于一个既有的真实标准，该标准同时定义了指令本身及其验证器。在九个前沿模型中，表现最强的模型解决率仅为18.5%，69个任务中有38个没有任何模型能够解决。我们发布了 Mult
tldr: 提出长时程基准 Multi-step SWE，包含69个由5-15个依赖步骤组成的软件工程任务链，要求智能体在自身编写的代码上持续迭代开发，最强前沿模型的解决率仅18.5%，揭示了当前编程智能体在长时程自我延续开发中的严重不足。
en_tdlr: Introducing Multi-step SWE, a long-horizon benchmark of 69 chained software engineering tasks where coding agents must iteratively build on their own code, revealing that even the strongest frontier model achieves only an 18.5% solve rate, exposing severe limitations in sustained, self-dependent software development.
